sentences.en: A link is provided to the SYFPEITHI database of MHC ligands and peptide motifs for more detailed information about anchor residues and binding motifs.

sentences.en: Biochemists call these thick muscle fibers myosin heavy chain proteins (MHC ).

sentences.en: Vega database for dog contains 700 kbp of the MHC region on chromosome 12 comprising fully annotated clones only.
